title: what's the point?
text: what's the point?. This was a dumb buy for the price as it offers nothing extra special for its stated purpose.  It's just a piece of plastic with indents and one of those unnecessary products that sound good at the time.  Takes up too much counter space for me and I could just as easily turn my chemex upside-down on a dishtowel or in the dish drain.  I suppose it will make it marginally less likely the glass will break and allows air to circulate but I thought the material would be special.  It's not.  So. average.
